content.text:
The drawing shows Ph–C(=O)–CH2–C(=O)–OEt, which is ethyl benzoylacetate (ethyl 3-oxo-3-phenylpropanoate).

- Left side: a phenyl group (Ph) bonded to a carbonyl carbon drawn with a C=O double bond.
- Middle: a single CH2 carbon linking the two carbonyl carbons.
- Right side: a second carbonyl carbon (C=O) bonded to an oxygen carrying an ethyl group (OEt), so an ethyl ester.

There are no wedges, hashes or double-bond geometry in the drawing, so no stereochemistry is included.

SMILES: CCOC(=O)CC(=O)c1ccccc1
